title: Mapped SI Engine
text: Spark-ignition engine model using lookup tables, 3 inputs, 2 outputs; {Include turbocharger lag effect} sets the increase time constant, {Input engine temperature} sets the create input port, {Calibrate Maps} sets the calibrate tables with measured data, {Breakpoints for commanded torque, f_tbrake_t_bpt} sets the breakpoints 1 -by, {Breakpoints for engine speed input, f_tbrake_n_bpt} sets the breakpoints 1 -by, {Breakpoints for temperature input, f_tbrake_engtmp_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Number of cylinders, NCyl}, {Crank revolutions per power stroke, Cps}, {Total displaced volume, Vd} sets the volume, {Fuel lower heating value, Lhv} sets the heating value 45e6, {Fuel specific gravity, Sg} sets the specific gravity, {Ideal gas constant air, Rair} sets the constant, {Air standard pressure, Pstd} sets the pressure, {Air standard temperature, Tstd} sets the temperature, {Boost torque line, f_tbrake_bst} sets the boost lag 1 -by, {Time constant below boost line, tau_thr}, {Rising torque boost time constant, tau_bst_rising} sets the rising time constant, {Falling torque boost time constant, tau_bst_falling} sets the falling time constant, {Brake torque map, f_tbrake} sets the 2D lookup table M -by, {Plot brake torque map} plots table, {Brake torque map, f_tbrake_3d} sets the 3D lookup table M -by- N -by, {Air mass flow map, f_air} sets the 2D lookup table M -by, {Plot air mass map} plots table, {Air mass flow map, f_air_3d} sets the 3D lookup table M -by- N -by, {Fuel flow map, f_fuel} sets the 2D lookup table M -by, {Plot fuel flow map} plots table, {Fuel flow map, f_fuel_3d} sets the 3D lookup table M -by- N -by, {Exhaust temperature map, f_texh} sets the 2D lookup table M -by, {Plot exhaust temperature map} plots table, {Exhaust temperature map, f_texh_3d} sets the 3D lookup table array, {BSFC map, f_eff} sets the 2D lookup table M -by- N -by, {Plot BSFC map} plots table, {BSFC map, f_eff_3d} sets the 3D lookup table M -by- N -by, {EO HC map, f_hc} sets the 2D lookup table M -by, {Plot EO HC map} plots table, {EO HC map, f_hc_3d} sets the 3D lookup table M -by- N -by, {EO CO map, f_co} sets the 2D lookup table M -by, {Plot EO CO map} plots table, {EO NOx map, f_nox} sets the 2D lookup table M -by, {Plot EO NOx map} plots table, {EO NOx map, f_nox_3d} sets the 3D lookup table M -by- N -by, {EO CO2 map, f_co2} sets the 2D lookup table M -by, {Plot CO2 map} plots table, {EO CO2 map, f_co2_3d} sets the 3D lookup table M -by- N -by, {EO PM map, f_pm} sets the 2D lookup table M -by, {Plot EO PM map} plots table and {EO PM map, f_pm_3d} sets the 3D lookup table M -by- N -by. Values come from the instance.
